tasks.instructions: Use Effect to implement export function adapt(signal: AbortSignal, work: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<string>): Promise<{ kind: 'success'; value: string } | { kind: 'failure'; message: string } | { kind: 'interrupted' }>. A host abort must interrupt the request and abort downstream Promise work, even if that work never settles. Already-aborted requests must not start work. Ordinary rejected Error messages must be preserved as failure, not interruption. Successful work must preserve its value. Do not install host services.

Use Effect Config to implement export function settings(values: Record<string, string>): Promise<{ host: string; port: number }>. Read HOST (required nonempty string) and PORT (optional, default 8123). A supplied PORT must be a decimal integer in 1..65535; malformed, empty, zero, negative, fractional and out-of-range values must reject. A missing PORT must not discard HOST. Do not read ambient process.env; the supplied map is the entire configuration source.

Use Effect to implement export function lookup(requests: ReadonlyArray<{ tenant: string; id: string }>, fetch: (tenant: string, ids: ReadonlyArray<string>) => Promise<Readonly<Record<string, string>>>): Promise<Array<string | null>>. Batch into exactly one fetch per distinct tenant, deduplicating IDs within that tenant. Preserve original order and duplicates in the result, mapping absent IDs to null. Never share data or a batch between tenants. Empty input makes no fetches. Any fetch rejection rejects the operation. Fake fetch functions are injected; no live services.
